**Finding: missing (INSURANCE) — redline validated and submitted.**

- **Investigation:** A full-text search for "insurance" returned zero hits; the document is a single 75-paragraph MSA, and I read all of it. Section 14 General Provisions (p0063–p0073) covers governing law, publicity, independent contractor status, fees, notices, severability, force majeure, assignment and counterparts — but no insurance or certificate requirement anywhere.
- **Direction check:** The rule binds the vendor, and Kubient is the counterparty. Its own warranty at p0035 confirms it collects, maintains and stores visitor data, and it hosts the Auction Platform — so it is a services/hosting vendor touching AP data. No insurance for such a vendor is the playbook's walk-away scenario, which makes this a genuine gap rather than a minor sub-element.
- **Redline:** Inserted a new Section 14(j) after p0073 at the preferred position (CGL USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where Kubient touches Customer data or visitor information, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request), tied to the defined Term plus one year and using the document's defined "Law". The comment offers the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) as a landing zone.
